# Wireless ML Data Hub

A task-oriented guide to datasets for machine learning in wireless communications.

Instead of starting from an unstructured list of dataset names, Wireless ML Data Hub starts from the **wireless research task**: channel estimation, beam prediction, localization, spectrum sensing, wireless sensing, RAN resource allocation, and more.

Each dataset is described with structured metadata and linked to the wireless tasks it demonstrably supports.

## What this project records

The catalogue distinguishes between:

- the **wireless task** a researcher wants to study;
- the **dataset, dataset family, or dataset collection** that may support that task;
- the relevant **inputs, targets, evaluation references, environment, mobility, and frequency context**;
- the dataset's **origin** such as measurement, ray tracing, simulation, synthetic generation, or hybrid acquisition;
- **access, licensing, provenance, and verification status**;
- evidence supporting every Task↔Dataset association.

A dataset may support several wireless tasks, and a task may have many datasets. The catalogue therefore models Task↔Dataset as a many-to-many relationship rather than forcing datasets into a single hierarchy.

## Curation principles

Wireless ML Data Hub is designed as a curated research resource, not as an automatically scraped directory.

Task mappings require evidence from the dataset authors, documentation, publications, or demonstrated uses. A task is not added merely because a dataset appears technically capable of supporting it.

The catalogue also distinguishes dataset identity from associated papers and checks for duplicate or potentially duplicate records before new entries are accepted.

## Repository structure

```text
data/
  datasets/          Canonical core dataset metadata
  tasks/             Wireless-task definitions
  collections/       Cross-cutting thematic collections
  resources/         Supporting benchmarks and discovery resources
  vocabularies.yaml  Controlled vocabularies

catalog/
  README.md           Generated task-oriented catalogue
  datasets.md         Generated all-datasets index
  resources.md        Generated supporting-resource index
  technologies.md     Generated wireless-technology index
  tasks/              Generated task pages
  datasets/           Generated dataset profiles
  collections/        Generated cross-cutting collection pages
  technologies/       Generated technology pages

dist/
  catalog.json        Generated machine-readable catalogue

schema/               JSON Schemas
scripts/              Validation, duplicate checking, and generation
tests/                Repository integrity tests
```

The files under `data/` are the source of truth. Files under `catalog/` and `dist/catalog.json` are generated and should not be edited manually.

## Using the data programmatically

`dist/catalog.json` contains the populated tasks, core dataset records, cross-cutting collections, supporting resources, task categories, and controlled vocabularies used by the catalogue. It is intended to support downstream interfaces such as search tools, websites, and grounded assistants without parsing Markdown.

See [Machine-readable catalogue](docs/machine-readable.md) for the format and update policy.

## Contributing

You can contribute by suggesting a dataset, reporting a metadata correction, proposing a missing wireless task, or submitting a structured dataset record.

Before submitting a new record, please read [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md) and the [curation guidelines](docs/curation-guidelines.md).

## Scope

The catalogue focuses on reusable datasets and dataset collections that are relevant to machine learning for wireless communications and related wireless sensing/network-intelligence tasks.

It does **not** treat a channel model, simulator, paper, code repository, or benchmark claim as a dataset unless a reusable data resource is actually available and appropriately identified.
